_meta.note: The project's own configuration: TAS on, recall selection on, plan gate on, x first; `xFirst: true` and `deliver: true` come from `cellPolicy('C4')` (packages/core/src/types.ts) and are not repeated here, because a value in this file would silently override the cell. _meta.caveat: `recall.minRecalledShare` is set to 0.25 below while the policy default is 0, and in this preset the knob is live (recall selection runs). types.ts records why 0 is the default: at 0.25 the token-share floor fired on 9 of 9 steps of a live C4 session, so every System-1 selection was replaced by recency. Left unchanged here - choosing the value back is a run decision, not a schema one.
_meta.retry: `s1.retryAttempts: 2` is set below per docs/CELLS-RUN.md's setup, and this cell needs it most: C4 makes an order of magnitude more System-1 calls than the other two arms, the shared Laya refuses rather than queues at its admission limit, and a measured round lost 732 of 2 016 calls to `503 server busy` - a refused call falls back to the local lexical scorer, so an unrecovered refusal turns an S1-governed cell into a partly lexical one. The retry waits the server's own `Retry-After` and is answered, and `attempts`/`waitedMs` on the `s1_call` record report how often it was needed; report `judgedPairs / scoredPairs` either way.
